children.text: Nothing checks the design before it’s done.
Your first review model looks, then checks the fixes.
One model looks, in turn; then all check the fixes.
All your review models look, then all check the fixes. Slower, and the most thorough.
You choose who reviews each round, who approves, and the goal.
They take turns in this order.
Review leaves Agents for a section of its own, under the project.
Level is a list of five options, each with its line always in view, not a segmented control whose line changes. Standard says Recommended.
Custom’s rows sit indented under Custom, shown when it is chosen; the score field follows ‘A score’.
Review models are chips in their order, each removable, with Add a model.
A reset arrow beside a setting changed from its default (T3 Code’s ↺).
